_description: Dataset/DataLoader configuration. Keys starting with '_' are documentation. Loaded by wakeword_data.load_config(); build_dataloaders() accepts overrides for batch_size / num_workers / seed.

augmentation._rir_bank: Curated RIR manifest (columns: id, filepath, rt60_s), relative to the project root; null disables rir_reverberation. Since 2026-09-29: 132 real impulse responses from the MIT IR Survey (CC-BY 4.0) with RT60 in the configured 0.15-0.6 s, built by deployment_driven_augmentation_strategy/build_rir_bank.py.

sampling._strategy: Each training epoch draws epoch_size examples. Every bucket (a set of window_types) receives a fixed share of the draws, so the abundant easy negatives cannot crowd out positives and hard negatives. Within a bucket, a window's weight is proportional to 1 / (windows from its source_group) ^ source_group_exponent, so one long recording cannot dominate its bucket. Draws are with replacement; each draw gets its own augmentation seed (seed, epoch, draw position).
sampling._source_group_exponent: 0 = every window equally likely; 1 = every source group equally likely. 0.5 is a compromise: long sessions still contribute more, but only as the square root of their window count.
sampling._sources: A bucket may restrict itself to 'real' (our manual recordings), 'synthetic' (generated) or 'external' (public-corpus human audio, source ext_*) sources; default all three. Every (window_type, source) pair in train must belong to exactly one bucket.
sampling._shares: Natural train mix: 4.5% positive, 25.7% hard negative, 69.8% easy negative. Target: 25% positive, 34% hard negative (confusables and partial wakewords), 41% easy negative. v3 (2026-09-28): the source-confound diagnostic (evaluation/diagnostics) showed the recording condition predicting the label, because positives were ~64% real audio and negatives ~5%. Positives are now split evenly between real and synthetic sources (synthetic positives were under-drawn by source-group weighting), and real device background rises from 8% to 14%, the only real negative recorded on the device. Real audio remains more common among positives than negatives until more RPI negatives are recorded. 2026-09-28: Manual-BG-RPI14..19 (real conversation, singing, near-miss "Hey ..." phrases, room sound) raised train real-background windows 278 -> 1,257, so device_background rises 14% -> 20% (general speech 15% -> 12%, media 8% -> 5%). 2026-09-29: public-corpus negatives added (MSWC near-miss words, FLEURS, MUSAN). ~7,300 one-word MSWC clips would otherwise fill the confusable and partial buckets and crowd out the phrase-level "Hey X" confusables, so they get their own bucket, taken from confusable and partial_wakeword. The same day the real "Hey Snips" phrases (Sonos, 2,000 clips) joined it, and it was renamed external_confusable (8%). Final shares: confusable 20% -> 13%, partial_wakeword 14% -> 13%, external_confusable 8%; the hard-negative total stays 34%.

evaluation._splits: Sequential, unsampled, unaugmented: the natural distribution, so metrics are not distorted by training quotas. streaming_eval_holdout can also be loaded (build_dataloaders(splits=[...])), never augmented.
